dedicated.name: Juri's Scales of Justice

why_by_stat.EffectRes: Helps Juri resist enemy effects and perform their role more reliably. Going above 100% Effect Resistance can still be useful.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Juri by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"The scales of justice do not lie! Your excuses have run out. Now it is time to pay the price of your sins — weighed in full!"

Juri stood before the crooked nobles and raised the Scales of Justice high, condemning them for abusing their status and influence to skirt the law and commit crimes with impunity. Leaving a shimmering afterimage in their wake, the scales vibrated eerily before tipping off-balance, unmistakably tilting toward symbolizing the nobles' sins. Glaring at the nobles still desperate to stick their heads in the sand to avoid their guilt, Juri delivered a cold, penetrating judgment that cuts straight to their souls.

lore:
As the former Fourth Seat of the Celestial Guardians, Juri presided over the courts and legal system. Her counterpart was Freyja, the First Seat, who presides over the executive branch and the military.
But the two are nothing alike. Freyja works toward her own ideals of justice while Juri stubbornly sticks to the letter of the law.
The difference in ideology between the two often led them to butt heads.
They notably did so during an incident where a group of celestial nobles tried to obtain greater power by experimenting with the Power of Destruction from Gaia.
Their actions went against an ancient treaty signed between the Celestial Realm and the ground below, so these nobles adjusted the terms of the treaty in order to continue their research.
They also kidnapped lowborn children in order to conduct these experiments with the Power of Destruction.
In response, Freyja sent her troops to put an end to them.
However, the amended laws and treaty meant that the nobles' actions were protected under the law.
Juri ended up having to take the position that those actions, however inhumane, were completely legal, and therefore needed to be protected.
She knew that morally, this was wrong, so she feigned resistance and intentionally lost to Freyja.
Freyja, realizing what Juri had done, spared her and asked her to return to her position so they could work for the good of the Celestial Realm together.
But Juri could not forgive herself for going against her principles and the law.
She left the Celestial Realm for the ground below in order to investigate the Power of Destruction and find out the truth for herself.
